name: How often should accessibility features in my home be inspected?

mainEntity.name: How often should accessibility features in my home be inspected?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of inspections for accessibility features depends on their type, usage, and material. High-traffic items like ramps and automatic door openers may require annual checks, while grab bars or shower seats could be inspected every 1-2 years. It's also advisable to perform a visual check after any significant weather events or if you notice any changes in functionality or stability. City Dweller, LLC can help establish a suitable maintenance schedule tailored to your specific home and installed features.
